job.title: Support Engineer
job.description:
We're looking for an IT Support Engineer to join a growing team in Sydney, supporting a modern Microsoft environment and playing a key role in ensuring employees have the tools and support they need to succeed.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to remain hands-on while expanding their exposure to cloud technologies, modern workplace solutions, and infrastructure support.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Provide end-user support across Microsoft technologies and workplace systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve incidents, service requests, and technical issues
  • Support and administer Microsoft Intune and Entra ID environments
  • Manage device provisioning, endpoint management, and application deployments
  • Administer and support SharePoint Online and collaboration technologies
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure a high level of service delivery
  • Contribute to problem management and continuous improvement initiatives
About You
  • Experience in IT Support, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or Infrastructure Support roles
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 technologies
  • Hands-on experience supporting Intune and Entra ID
  • Experience with device lifecycle management and endpoint administration
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities
If you're looking for your next step in IT support and want to work in a modern Microsoft environment where you can continue to grow your technical capabilities, apply now!

job.title: Support Officer
job.description:
Are you a passionate IT Support professional who enjoys solving technical issues, helping end users, and taking ownership of your work?

We're partnering with a well-established organisation seeking an IT Support Officer to become the local face of IT support. This is a hands-on role offering autonomy, variety, and the opportunity to make a genuine impact while working closely with a broader IT team.

If you're someone who enjoys being on the frontline of technology support and thrives in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

What You Will Be Doing
  • Provide support across hardware, software, Microsoft 365, printing, mobile devices, and connectivity issues.
  • Act as the first point of contact for incidents, service requests, and user enquiries.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve desktop, laptop, and peripheral-related issues.
  • Support device provisioning, deployment, and onboarding activities.
  • Maintain asset registers, device inventories, and stock levels.
  • Assist with endpoint management and user access administration.
  • Work closely with a remote IT team to ensure a high level of service delivery across the business.
  • Escalate complex issues when required and follow through to resolution.
About You
  • 2+ years' experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, Desktop Support, or similar role.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows and Microsoft 365 environments.
  • Experience supporting end users in a corporate environment.
  • Familiarity with device deployment, onboarding, and endpoint management.
  • Exposure to technologies such as:
    • Microsoft Intune
    • Windows Autopilot
    • SharePoint Online
    • OneDrive
    • Microsoft Teams
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Well organised, proactive, and comfortable working independently.
  • A genuine passion for technology and helping users.
If you're looking for your next IT support opportunity and want to join an organisation where you can make a real impact, apply now!

job.title: Analytics Engineer
job.description:
We're partnering with a well-established organisation undertaking an exciting data and analytics transformation and are seeking an experienced Analytics Engineer to join the team on an initial 3-month contract.

This role will play a key part in delivering a backlog of high-priority reporting and analytics initiatives, helping to build scalable data models and empower the business with meaningful insights.

Whether you're looking for a full-time contract or a part-time engagement, we'd love to hear from experienced professionals who can hit the ground running.
What You'll Be Doing
  • Design and develop dimensional data models using best-practice methodologies
  • Create and maintain semantic models within Power BI
  • Build intuitive dashboards and reports that drive business decision-making
  • Work across the Microsoft Fabric platform to deliver modern analytics solutions
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into reporting outcomes
  • Ensure data quality, consistency, and performance across reporting assets
  • Support the ongoing uplift of the organisation's analytics capability
About You You'll be a hands-on Analytics Engineer or Senior BI Developer who enjoys working closely with stakeholders and turning business requirements into impactful reporting solutions.
Key Skills & Experience
  • Strong experience with dimensional modelling (Kimball / Star Schema)
  • Advanced Power BI development skills, including DAX and semantic modelling
  • Practical experience with Microsoft Fabric
  • Strong SQL skills
  • Experience managing and delivering reporting backlogs
  • Ability to engage with stakeholders and translate business needs into technical solutions
  • Strong communication and documentation skills
  • Experience working within Agile delivery environments
Desirable
  • Experience with Azure Data Services
  • Data engineering exposure across modern cloud platforms
  • Understanding of data governance and self-service analytics principles

job.title: Reporting Lead
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Reporting Lead to drive reporting, analytics, and automation capabilities across the organisation. This role will lead the design, development, automation, and optimisation of enterprise reporting solutions while partnering with senior business leaders to deliver actionable insights that support strategic decision-making.

The successful candidate will combine deep technical expertise in Power BI, SQL, Microsoft Fabric, and report automation with exceptional stakeholder management skills. You will be responsible for transforming complex business requirements into scalable reporting and analytics solutions that improve visibility, performance, and decision-making across the business.

This is an opportunity to lead the evolution of a modern reporting function, leveraging Microsoft's data and analytics platform to build enterprise-grade, automated reporting capabilities.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the organisation's reporting and analytics capability, ensuring reliable, scalable, and business-focused reporting solutions.
  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade dashboards, reports, and visualisations using Power BI.
  • Develop and optimise datasets, semantic models, and reporting architectures using SQL and modern data platform technologies.
  • Leverage Microsoft Fabric to support data integration, transformation, governance, analytics, and reporting initiatives.
  • Lead the automation of reporting processes to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and increase reporting timeliness.
  • Design and implement automated data pipelines, report refresh schedules, alerting mechanisms, and report distribution processes.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline reporting workflows and eliminate manual reporting activities across the organisation.
  • Partner with senior executives and business leaders to understand strategic objectives, reporting requirements, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate complex business requirements into technical reporting and analytics solutions.
Skills & Experience Essential
  • Extensive experience in a Reporting Lead, BI Lead, Analytics Lead, or similar senior reporting role.
  • Advanced expertise in Power BI, including:
    • Data modelling
    • DAX
    • Power Query
    • Dashboard and report development
    • Performance optimisation
  • Strong hands-on experience with SQL for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
  • Proven experience working with and implementing solutions within Microsoft Fabric environments.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering report automation and enterprise reporting solutions.
  • Strong understanding of automated reporting processes, data orchestration, scheduling, and workflow optimisation.
  • Experience automating data ingestion, transformation, reporting, and dashboard refresh processes.
  • Exceptional senior stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage, influence, and challenge executive stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to gather requirements, define reporting strategies, and translate business needs into technical solutions.
Desirable
  • Experience with Azure Data Platform technologies.
  • Knowledge of data governance, data quality, and reporting frameworks.
  • Experience leading reporting, analytics, or business intelligence teams.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications in Power BI, Fabric, Data Analytics, or Azure.
  • Experience supporting self-service reporting and analytics initiatives.
What Success Looks Like
  • A trusted advisor to senior leadership on reporting, analytics, and data strategy.
  • Delivery of accurate, timely, and impactful business insights.
  • Significant reduction in manual reporting through automation and process improvement.
  • Increased adoption and maturity of Power BI and Microsoft Fabric capabilities.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and measurable business outcomes driven by data.
  • Improved reporting governance, efficiency, scalability, and data quality across the organisation.
Interested in exploring? Apply now! Interviews will be commencing soon.

job.title: SAP Support Analyst
job.description:
SAP Support Analyst (PP/MM/QM) Permanent Full-Time Role

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced SAP Support Analyst to join our team in a permanent capacity. This role will play a critical part in supporting and optimising our SAP environment, with a strong focus on SAP Production Planning (PP).

The successful candidate will act as the primary functional support resource for SAP PP, working closely with manufacturing, supply chain, and business stakeholders to ensure system stability, continuous improvement, and effective delivery of business outcomes. Experience across SAP Quality Management (QM) and Materials Management (MM) is also essential.

This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on SAP professional who enjoys investigating issues, supporting users, driving enhancements, and contributing to ongoing SAP initiatives.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide day-to-day functional support across SAP PP, MM and QM modules.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for SAP Production Planning (PP) and lead the resolution of complex production-related issues.
  • Analyse business requirements and translate them into SAP solutions and system enhancements.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve incidents, problems and service requests.
  • Work closely with manufacturing, procurement, warehouse and quality teams to optimise business processes.
  • Support system upgrades, testing activities, change requests and enhancement projects.
  • Develop and maintain functional specifications, process documentation and user training materials.
  • Collaborate with external vendors, technical teams and business stakeholders to ensure effective service delivery.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to maximise SAP capability and business value.
About You To be successful in this role, you will have:

Essential Experience
  • Significant experience as an SAP Support Analyst, SAP Functional Consultant, or similar role.
  • Strong SAP Production Planning (PP) experience, including configuration, support and troubleshooting.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting production and manufacturing processes within SAP.
  • Solid hands-on experience with SAP Materials Management (MM).
  • Solid hands-on experience with SAP Quality Management (QM).
  • Experience managing incidents, service requests, problem management and enhancement delivery.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and business partnering skills.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Desirable Experience
  • Experience in manufacturing, industrial, consumer goods, food processing, mining or related industries.
  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA environments.
  • Knowledge of SAP integration points across Supply Chain, Procurement and Warehouse processes.
  • Experience participating in SAP transformation, upgrade or optimisation projects.
What We Offer
  • Permanent, long-term career opportunity.
  • Opportunity to work within a highly collaborative and supportive team.
  • Exposure to ongoing SAP enhancement and improvement initiatives.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Professional development and growth opportunities.
Apply Now If you are an experienced SAP professional with strong SAP PP expertise and proven capabilities across MM and QM, we'd love to hear from you.

Join us and play a key role in supporting and enhancing critical manufacturing and supply chain business processes through SAP.
